CGEN NeuroSync: Closed-Loop BCI for Instant Workspace Adaptation I'm incredibly excited to announce the public release of CGEN NeuroSync. If you are a developer, creator, or technical builder, you know how exhausting "The Prompting Tax" is, the constant, manual context-switching and UI coordination required to get digital help tools to cooperate. CGEN NeuroSync completely eliminates that blockage. By utilizing a non-invasive, closed-loop Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), our system translates neural intent into instant workspace execution. Essentially, no manual prompting and no workflow lag. To make this seamless, I engineered a dual-agent framework that achieves an unprecedented sub 50ms edge processing latency: 1. Agent Synapse: Real-time biological noise/muscle artifact filtering and continuous calibration. 2. Agent CGEN: The dynamic UI/UX workspace adaptation engine. Watch the full video here to see the full architectural breakdown: https://lnkd.in/g3AHQMt5 LIVE Website - running full-stack pipeline (Fast API + JS) and streaming real-time visualizations: https://lnkd.in/gRFpWYxv ...more

Most engineering frameworks treat hardware, Artificial Intelligence, and biology as completely separate departments. However, the biggest breakthroughs over the next decade will happen exclusively at their intersection. To prove it, I spent the last few months digging into the history, methodologies, and emerging trends of cross-modal engineering. Today, I’m excited to officially share my research paper: "EE&Innovation". In this work, I break down: - The Convergence: How Electrical Engineering serves as the foundational architecture bridging biomedical telemetry and modern AI systems. - Historical Paradigms: What past hardware constraints can teach us about optimizing current resource-heavy deep-tech models. - Future Trends: Why the future of innovation belongs to interdisciplinary polymaths building at the absolute baseline of physical and digital systems. Whether you're building deep tech, researching neural architectures, or scaling hardware, I'd love to get your eyes on this and hear your feedback. Read the full open-access paper on ResearchGate here: https://lnkd.in/ggSuubrY If you want to support my independent research directly, you can grab the full published version on Publiread for $7 here: https://lnkd.in/g4ZujqeZ #DeepTech #ElectricalEngineering #ArtificialIntelligence #BiomedicalEngineering #Innovation ...more

I’m incredibly grateful to share that I had the opportunity to participate in the Yale Young Global Scholars (YYGS) program at Yale University this summer! 💙 With over 14,000 applicants globally, I’m incredibly grateful to have been among the 13% selected to participate in the program. Over two weeks, I learned alongside an inspiring community of students from around the world, challenged my perspectives, and experienced what it means to learn in a truly global and interdisciplinary environment. Throughout the program, I explored global issues through seminars, lectures, breakout discussions, and a final capstone project. From thought-provoking research about wealth and resource inequality to discussing and learning about global challenges from perspectives far beyond my own, YYGS pushed me to think more critically, ask better questions, and approach issues with greater nuance. A huge thank you to Sherry Huang , Joshua Z. , Liam Heraty , Lauren Johnson, Batyrkhan Kanash , and Liza S. for creating such an engaging and supportive environment. I’m also incredibly grateful to the YYGS program staff Zeva Manvi , Gaye Kim , Alexus Jade Coney for making the PLE (Politics, Law and Economics) track such a welcoming and memorable experience. Your guidance has made this experience incredibly meaningful, and I’m so grateful for everything you’ve done to make these two weeks extraordinary! But really, the most memorable part of YYGS was the people. I met students with remarkable passion, brilliant ideas, and an endless curiosity about the world, each using their talents to create change in their communities, pursue research, and make an impact. Their perspectives, stories, and ambitions inspired me to think bigger and challenge myself to do more. I’m incredibly grateful for the people I met, the lessons I learned, and the memories I’ll carry with me. I can’t wait to take what I’ve learned from this experience and do something with it! 💙 Thank you, YYGS, for an unforgettable summer! #YYGS #YaleYoungGlobalScholars #Yale #GlobalScholars #SummerProgram #Leadership
